Specification: This module specifies an inner FIFO buffer system connecting an input channel and an output channel, with an internal queue q storing messages in transit. The module is a TLC-oriented version of another specification that originally used INSTANCE statements; here the imported channel behavior is expanded manually into prefixed operators for the input and output channels. It models channel handshaking with rdy/ack bits, queueing of received input messages, forwarding from the head of the queue to the output channel, and proves that the specification implies a type invariant stating that both channels have the expected record structure and that q is a sequence of Message values.
